description.text:
Job Description
We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer to join our team, focusing on the development of our Manufacturing Systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, with a particular emphasis on the .NET framework and C# language.
Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain software applications for Manufacturing Systems.
- Develop web services using .NET, C#, SQL for development
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
- Work on bug fixing and improving application performance.
- Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency.
